units.source_text: 常陆守忙着准备次女的婚事，对夫人说：“你这里有许多漂亮的侍女，暂时借我一用吧。

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi was busy preparing for his second daughter's wedding, and said to his wife, "You have many pretty serving women here, so lend them to me for a while.

units.source_text: 帐幕等物，这里也有新制的，但时间匆促，来不及拿到那边去换，干脆就借用这里的房间吧。”

en.t: There are newly made curtains and hangings here too, but there is so little time that we cannot carry them over there and change everything, so let us simply borrow these rooms."

units.source_text: 他就来到浮舟所居的西所，有时站着，有时坐着，喧哗扰攘地装饰房间。

en.t: He then came to the western quarters where Ukifune lived, now standing, now sitting, noisily bustling about as he decorated the rooms.

units.source_text: 浮舟的房间本来布置得很美观，各处安排都很妥帖。

en.t: Ukifune's rooms had originally been beautifully arranged, with everything placed just as it should be.

units.source_text: 他却自作聪明地搬进些屏风来，东一个西一个地摆得乱七八糟；

en.t: But thinking himself clever, he brought in several screens and set them here and there in complete disorder;

units.source_text: 又不三不四地加入一个橱和一个双层柜。

en.t: he also awkwardly added a cabinet and a two-tiered cupboard that did not suit the room at all.

units.source_text: 常陆守如此策划，自鸣得意。

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi planned all this and was quite pleased with himself.

units.source_text: 夫人虽然觉得难看，但因决心不再插嘴，只是袖手旁观。

en.t: Although his wife thought it looked dreadful, she had resolved not to interfere again and merely stood by watching.

units.source_text: 于是浮舟只得迁居北所。

en.t: As a result, Ukifune had no choice but to move to the northern quarters.

units.source_text: 常陆守对夫人说：“你的心我完全知道了。

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi said to his wife, "Now I understand your feelings completely.

units.source_text: 同是你所生的女孩，想不到你对这一个如此冷淡。

en.t: She is a daughter born of you just like the other, and yet I never imagined you would be so cold toward this one.

units.source_text: 算了吧，世间没有母亲的女儿并非没有！”

en.t: So be it; there are daughters in this world who have no mother!"

units.source_text: 白昼里，常陆守就同乳母两人替女儿打扮装饰。

en.t: During the day, the Governor of Hitachi and the nurse together dressed and adorned his daughter.

units.source_text: 这女儿相貌也长得不坏，年纪大约十五六岁，身材矮小，体态圆肥。

en.t: The girl was not bad-looking, about fifteen or sixteen years old, short in stature, and round and plump in build.

units.source_text: 头发长得很美，和礼服一样长短，下端密密丛丛。

en.t: Her hair was long and beautiful, reaching the same length as her formal robes, and thick and full at the ends.

units.source_text: 常陆守觉得这头发很可爱，用手抚摩着，说道：“其实不一定要把企图娶别人的男子招为女婿。

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi thought her hair was lovely, and as he stroked it with his hand he said, "In truth, there is no real need to take as a son-in-law a man who means to marry someone else.

units.source_text: 然而这位少将人品高贵，才华盖世，多多少少的人都想招他为婿。

en.t: Still, this captain is of noble character and unmatched talent, and many people would like to bring him in as a son-in-law.

units.source_text: 让给别人多可惜啊！”他受了那媒人的骗而说这话，真是个傻瓜！

en.t: What a pity it would be to let someone else have him!" In saying this, deceived by that go-between, he was truly a fool.

units.source_text: 左近少将也听信媒人的话，知道常陆守如此殷勤看待，觉得万事都无缺陷，便不变更婚期，就在约定的那天晚上来入赘了。

en.t: Sakon no Shosho also believed the go-between's words, and when he heard how warmly the Governor of Hitachi was treating the matter, he thought everything was perfectly in order, did not change the wedding date, and came that very night as arranged to become their son-in-law.
